teaser.en: A wild grape with five-fingered leaves, scrambling through the coastal bush.

summary.en: Mwamchiviza is Cyphostemma buchananii, a climber of the grape family. Pakia records only its Digo name.

about.en: Mwamchiviza is a climbing or trailing herb of the grape family, with tendrils opposite the leaves. Like other Cyphostemmas it has leaves divided like a hand into several toothed leaflets, flat-topped clusters of tiny greenish-yellow flowers and small, juicy berries that ripen red.

where.en: It grows in bushland and thicket, scrambling over shrubs.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mwamchiviza but gives no meaning or shared names. Its scientific name is Cyphostemma buchananii.

taxon.matched_name: Cyphostemma buchananii (Planch.) Desc. ex Wild & R.B.Drumm.
